## Diagnosis (the contract's core ask)

`billing_export_prod` is empty **not** because of provider lag and **not** because the billing
account is misbound — it is empty because the **usage-cost export was never enabled**:

| Layer | Evidence (all 2026-11-11T23:3x–4xZ, committed in `reports/2026-11-11_258_R6OPS.2/`) |
|---|---|
| Billing account | `rhema-507501` → `billingAccounts/018CB8-639CF9-C243C7` ("Rhema", open, USD) ✓ |
| `billing_export_prod` | us-central1, Pulumi-provisioned 2026-10-03 — **zero tables, zero writes in 38 d, no billing writer in ACL** → never a destination |
| What IS bound | ONE DTS transfer config: **"Pricing BigQuery Transfer"** (SUCCEEDED) → `billing_export.cloud_pricing_export` — the **Pricing export** (list prices, not actuals); 1,263,711 rows, writing as of 2026-11-11T16:31Z |
| Usage-cost export | **none** — no standard/detailed transfer config in `rhema-507501` or any other billing-linked project; no `rhema_cost_export` dataset exists (the H10 checklist name never matched the provisioned dataset) |
| API surface | still none — `gcloud billing` GA+beta exposes accounts/budgets/projects only; console-only flip stands |

A billing→BigQuery pipeline was configured ~2026-10-29 (one day after R6CLK.1 surfaced the
empty dataset) — the operator selected the **Pricing** export tile to a fresh `billing_export`
dataset rather than the **usage-cost** export to the provisioned `billing_export_prod`.
